items.solution: An AI employee answers 24/7 from your business's WhatsApp number.
The agent checks availability and confirms bookings with no human intervention.
The system sends payment links and confirms every transaction in the same chat.

how.title: How it works in 3 steps
steps: Pick your assistants based on what your business needs.
Connect them to your WhatsApp Business number.
Direct them from a panel: what they do, when, and under which rules.

architecture.title: Architecture and stack
architecture.stack: Next.js + TypeScript on the frontend; Python backend with MCP tools on Cloud Run; WhatsApp Cloud API as the channel.
architecture.security: Keys only on the backend, per-IP and per-session limits, daily spend cap, antibot and input validation. The demo stores no personal data.

about.title: Who builds this
about.name: Jorge Grisales
lines: Architect of this factory: I design and operate systems of AI agents that serve customers over WhatsApp.
I work with the WhatsApp Cloud API, LLMs and payments (Wompi/Giroplay), from idea to production.
"I built this network of assistants": every character in the scene is a role an AI employee can take on in your business.

items.q: What is a WhatsApp Tech Provider?
items.a: A technology provider authorized by Meta to set up and manage other businesses' WhatsApp Cloud API: it registers the number, verifies it, and keeps the integration running.

items.q: How long does it take to get my factory ready?
items.a: TODO_CONTENT: implementation time depending on the type of business.

items.q: Which WhatsApp number do the assistants use?
items.a: Your business's own. Your customers write to the number they already know and the agents reply right there.

items.q: What happens to my data and my customers' data?
items.a: The demo stores no personal data. In real operation, data processing follows Colombian Law 1581 of 2012 and the contact form asks for explicit consent.
